function.name: save_source_file
function.description: Save reviewed complete files in the current server App Plan. Submit one or more same-type objects; reuse stable IDs for full replacement. Unsubmitted objects are retained, omitted optional fields in submitted objects are cleared. References must already exist or be included in this same-type batch. Empty arrays are a no-op. Requires an existing Blueprint. The entire batch is validated before one aggregate write; no runtime resources or progress are created.

sandbox.description: Optional sandbox name. Executes the operation in that sandbox site when provided.
